title: Game definition: Oware (West African mancala)
description: Oware/Awari: 2-player, 2×6 board (12 pits + 2 stores), 48 seeds. Counter-clockwise sowing, capture when last seed makes opponent pit 2 or 3 (grand slam protection). Most elegant mancala variant — used in international tournaments.
close_reason: Oware: 2×6 board, 48 seeds, counter-clockwise sowing, chain capture (2 or 3), grand slam protection. Validates against schema.
